explication: Hover Zoom+ is a browser extension that enlarges media when users hover over supported-site content. The main workflow is page interaction → site-specific URL or metadata resolution → full-size media display, with optional video playback and save/open actions. Preferences and plugin enablement provide a secondary control path. The tree and excerpts support the central runtime, background requests, Vinted bridging, and representative adapters; many other site adapters are represented collectively by the plugins directory.
